item.title: Youth Against Scam 2026 (#YAS2026) Video
item.description: Dear students, There is a competition Youth Against Scam 2026 (#YAS2026) organised by the Singapore Police Force to create an anti-scam video for their use. If you're interested, please take note of the details below and register for the competition. Regards Mr Teo Ming Ern Student Management +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ Greetings from the Singapore Police Force, 1. This email kindly invites Hwa Chong Institution to participate in the Youth Against Scams 2026 (#YAS2026) Video Competition. Details of #YAS2026 2. #YAS2026 is the fourth iteration of the Singapore Police Force, Clementi Police Division's anti-scam video competition that taps into youths' ability to create trendy scam education videos that resonate with their peers and leverages their social media networks to amplify SPF's anti-scam messaging efforts. 3. This year, #YAS2026 will be held from 01 May 2026 12:00am to 31 August 2026 6:00pm. The competition features two categories: a) Secondary School Category, open to all current students from secondary schools, and b) Tertiary Education Category, open to all current students from the following education institutions: Institute of Technical Education, Polytechnics (including Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts and LASALLE College of the Arts), Junior Colleges, Universities, and Private Schools for Secondary and Tertiary Education 4. Students may participate individually or in teams. Teams must comprise students from the same school only. Interested students may register via the following Registration Form: https://go.gov.sg/yas2026-registration Students who successfully register early will receive complimentary access to an exclusive videography and acting workshop conducted by Ngee Ann Polytechnic's Film & Media Studies and Singapore Drama Educators Association to equip them with essential skills to create high-quality video content and boost their chances of winning! 5. Participants are required to create TikTok and/or Instagram video(s) covering at least one scam and/or scam-related offence affecting youths based on open-source information. Their videos will be judged based on two criteria – Virality and Content – and winners can look forward to receiving attractive cash prizes! 6. The full Rules and Regulations of the competition are available via the following link: https://t968-p135-blue.stg.cwp2.sg/-/media/SPF/Advisories/Scams/Rules-and-Regulations-YAS-2026-FINAL.pdf. +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

item.title: [LD] Sign up for LifeAtEDB (Pre-University) Outreach programme (closing date: 1 June)
item.description: Dear students, Are you curious about what a career in economic development looks like? Interested in finding out more about the EDB scholarship? Here's your chance! We are pleased to share that the Economic Development Board (EDB) is hosting LifeAtEDB (Pre-University) — an event specially designed for pre-university students like you. Date: Tuesday, 23 June Time: 2.00pm – 4.30pm (Registration opens at 1.30pm) Venue: EDB Office (Level 21) Here's what you can look forward to: • Interactive games to discover what EDB does in a fun, hands-on way • Fireside chat with EDB officers to hear about their scholarship journey and day-to-day work • Networking session to connect with EDB officers and fellow students Whether you are exploring scholarship options or simply want to learn more about EDB, this is a great opportunity to get your questions answered. If you are interested, please register early - you can scan the QR code in the poster or click here . Do note that registration closes on 1 June 2026 . Regards, Ms Ng Li San Leadership Development Unit

item.title: [SE] Sign Up: Exclusive Mock Interview Training with World Champion Trainer Mr Darren Tay
item.description: Dear C2 students, Prepare for your future university and scholarship applications with an elite edge. The Student Enrichment Unit (SE) is proud to invite you to an exclusive Mock Interview Training Session led by Mr Darren Tay, a world-renowned keynote speaker, coach, and professional trainer. Accompanied by an assistant, Mr Tay will provide a rigorous, high-stakes environment to sharpen your interview presence. This is a rare opportunity to receive direct, verbal evaluations from an expert in communication. Event Details Date: 29 May 2026 (Last day of Term 2) Time: 8:00 am - 3:00 pm (30 min group slots) Venue: Conference and Meeting Rooms (next to College Reception) Format: Small group coaching (4 - 6 students per group) Session Highlights Students are required to arrive 15 minutes before their allocated slot. During this time, you will: Draft one to two interview questions on the spot in the conference room Each group will then go through a structured 30-minute cycle with Mr Tay in the meeting room: 25 minutes: Active interview fielding and critique of your drafted questions, along with personalised verbal feedback on your performance 5 minutes: Buffer for Q&A and transition Each session includes a personalised verbal evaluation to highlight your strengths and areas for improvement. Registration & Important Notes Placements are strictly limited to 12 groups only. To ensure a quality experience, registration is on a first-come, first-served basis. Registration will close on Tuesday, 26 May. [SIGN UP HERE] If you are unable to attend this session, a second run will be offered in Term 3. Students who are unable to attend both sessions may continue to build their interview skills by accessing resources on the SE Unit website (link), and/or by using the VirtualSpeech programme available on the Meta headsets in the Jing Xian Library for self-directed practice. Prioritise your Schedule: Please ensure you have accounted for your C2 Student Focused Conversations (SFC) and CCA commitments. Plan your time well to avoid scheduling conflicts. Attendance Policy: As this session is fully funded by the SE Unit, please email corinnelee@hci.edu.sg immediately if you have registered but are subsequently unable to attend, so your spot can be offered to a peer. Don’t miss this valuable opportunity to refine your communication skills and strengthen your interview readiness Best regards, Student Enrichment Unit [SE]
